php-diff-text now reaches parity with `vue-diff-text` and the new `react-diff-text`. All three follow one behavior contract and pass the same shared fixtures, so PHP renders the same markup as the JavaScript packages, byte for byte.

```bash
composer require sitefinitysteve/php-diff-text:^1.6
```

**Live demo:** https://sitefinitysteve.github.io/diff-text/php/

## New

- **Line views:**
  - `DiffText::unified()`: line numbers and folded context.
  - `DiffText::split()`: side by side, with the changed words highlighted inside edited lines.
- **`DiffText::stats()`:** a badge with added, removed and unchanged counts, plus a similarity percentage.
- **Visualizations,** all static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript:
  - `DiffText::heatmap()`: a rewrite heatmap.
  - `detectMoves`: moved blocks.
  - `minimap`: a strip of links to every change.
  - `DiffText::timeline()`: step through several revisions.
  - `DiffText::playback()`: animated playback.
- **New options:**
  - every text mode: `ignoreCase`, `maxEditLength`;
  - lines: `ignoreWhitespace`, `newlineIsToken`, `stripTrailingCr`.

## Fixed

- **Word and sentence diffs** no longer drop the spaces between words.
- **The HTML diff is tag-aware:**
  - it never splits a tag or produces broken markup;
  - content after `<script>`/`<style>` is kept;
  - entities compare by value (`&eacute;` equals `é`).
- **The engine is rewritten** as a port of jsdiff v8's Myers search. The old engine used memory proportional to both input sizes multiplied together, and ran out at about 5 KB. A 10,000-character diff with small edits now takes about 2 ms and 2 MB.
- **Similarity** stays between 0 and 1.
- **Invalid UTF-8** consistently becomes U+FFFD.
- **ignoreCase** matches JavaScript on PHP 8.1–8.4.

## Upgrading

The API is backward compatible, but some output changed on purpose:

- **Full replacement** uses `<div>` wrappers instead of `<span>`.
- **Change attributes:** changes carry `data-change-index`.
- **Escaping:** `'` is escaped as `&#39;`.
- **Tokens:** `Tokenizer::words()` and `Tokenizer::sentences()` return jsdiff's tokens.

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/sitefinitysteve/diff-text/blob/main/packages/php/CHANGELOG.md).

## Where development happens

This package now lives in [`packages/php` of the diff-text monorepo](https://github.com/sitefinitysteve/diff-text/tree/main/packages/php), and this repository is a read-only mirror that Packagist reads. Your `composer require` doesn't change. Please open issues and pull requests on [diff-text](https://github.com/sitefinitysteve/diff-text).
